description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5360008627915 SPRING,HELICAL,COMP: Line 0001 Qty 14 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0018 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
